description: Navigate to the 'Puzzle of famous paintings' activity in GCompris (located in the Puzzles category, icon looks like a puzzle piece). Complete the first puzzle presented by dragging the pieces to their correct positions. Once the puzzle is fully assembled and the painting's name/artist is displayed, take a screenshot of the completed state and save it to '/home/ga/Documents/painting_solved.png'. Read the name of the painting or artist shown on screen and save this text into a file named '/home/ga/Documents/painting_info.txt'.
